posts.trend: India’s Alcobev Industry Gears Up for Festive and Wedding Season as Premium Liquor Demand Rises
posts.context: At thirty, buying expensive liquor has nothing to do with status and everything to do with preventing a two-day hangover.
posts.angle: What the alcohol industry calls premiumisation is actually just thirty-year-olds buying medical insurance for tomorrow morning.

landing_options.line: Bottle mehengi thi. Sab 10:45 pe so gaye.
Sabne ek glass piya aur sabko neend aa gayi.
Hangover ab 2 din chalta hai, jaise bank ka server.
Kal subah sabko physio ke paas jaana hai.

slides: 30 pe "premium alcohol" shauk nahi, medical insurance hai.

22 pe: sasti rum, plastic glass, subah 9 baje class.
30 pe: ₹5,500 ki single malt, side table pe Electral.
